RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, December 11, 2013/Agrahayana 20, 1935 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Defence; Home Affairs;
Information and Broadcasting; Labour and Employment: Social Justice
and Empowerment; Textiles; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Recruitment of senior officers of IB
from IPS cadre
*81. SHRI NARESH GUJRAL: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that all senior
officers of  Intelligence Bureau (IB) are IPS
Officers from States who are absorbed in
IB;
(b) the criterion of their selection;
(c) whether there is a selection board
which is responsible for recruiting them; and
(d) whether they are given any
specialised training after their recruitment
to this investigative agency, and if so, the
details thereof?
Continuous losses to NTC due to
irregularities
*82. DR. PRADEEP KUMAR
BALMUCHU: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Textile Corporation (NTC) due to serious
irregularities is running into continuous
losses;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the remedial measures being taken
by Government to curb the irregularities
and keep running NTC in a healthy
atmosphere?
Mudgal Committee report on the
Cinematograph Act, 1952
*83. SHRI T.M. SELVAGANAPATHI:
Will the Minister of INFORMA TION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Mudgal
Committee which was constituted to
update the Cinematograph Act, 1952, has
submitted its report to Government;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the said
Committee has proposed for legal check
on States banning films;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the said
Committee has also submitted model
Cinematograph Bill to replace the
Cinematograph Act, 1952; and
(d) if so, the views of Government on
the report submitted by the said Committee
and whether Government is considering to

27
implement the recommendations, if so, the
details thereof?
New National Textile Policy
*84. SHRI HUSAIN DALW AI: Will
the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has
constituted an Expert Committee to
formulate a new National Textile Policy;
(b) if so, the need for a new Textile
Policy;
(c) how it would be an improvement
over the existing policy;
(d) the objectives of the new Textile
Policy; and
(e) whether the new policy would be
fabric neutral unlike the present one which
is in favour of cotton?
Inclusion of Bhojpuri in Eighth
Schedule
*85. SHRI RAJIV PRATAP RUDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
the demand to include Bhojpuri in the Eighth
Schedule of the Constitution and also to
give it classical status;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the time-frame, and if not, the reasons
therefor;
(c) the details of the total number of
Bhojpuri speaking people in the country
and also the number of Bhojpuri speaking
People of Indian Origin (PIO) in different
parts of the world; and
(d) the details of funds allocated for the
development of Bhojpuri language?
Industrial growth rate
*86. SHRI SHADI LAL BATRA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of industrial
growth in the country;
(b) whether the rate of industrial growth
has declined during the current year as
compared to the last year;
(c) if so, the sector/month-wise details
thereof and the reasons therefor;
(d) the State/Union Territory-wise
number of industries which have been
closed down during the said period; and
(e) the corrective measures taken/being
taken by Government in this regard?
Exploitation of children by TV
channels
†*87. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is not a fact that minor
children in the school-going and playing
age by their participation in competitions
like dancing, singing etc. are being exploited
by various TV entertainment channels;
(b) if so, whether Government has
prepared/proposes to prepare any plan
with regard to putting a check on such
programmes of children on entertainment
TV channels to save them from becoming
source of income in the name of art and if
so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

28
Assistance to Goa under the Coastal
Security Scheme
*88. SHRI SHANTARAM NAIK: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Coastal Security
Scheme is still in force;
(b) if so, the essential features of the
scheme;
(c) the item-wise assistance given to the
State of Goa, till date; and
(d) the details of achievements under
the scheme in the State?
Naxal threat in West Bengal
*89. SHRI VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
perceives any new naxal threat in West
Bengal;
(b)

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, December 11, 2013/Agrahayana 20, 1935 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Defence; Home Affairs;
Information and Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Social Justice and
Empowerment; Textiles; Y outh Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 155
Issue of MSP in Ninth WTO
Ministerial Conference
621. SHRI D. RAJA:
SHRI M.P. ACHUTHAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the issue of
our Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for
farmers and food subsidies are likely to
come up in the forthcoming Ninth WTO
Ministerial Conference scheduled for
December, 2013 in Bali; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
position India is expected to take in the
conference on this issue?
FDI in pharma sector
622. SHRI D. RAJA:
SHRI M.P. ACHUTHAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Standing
Committee on Commerce has
recommended a blanket ban on Foreign
Direct Investment (FDI) in existing pharma
projects and urged that further takeover/
acquisition of domestic pharma units be
stopped;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
important Ministries like Finance and
Health and Family Welfare are strongly
pitching for urgent reversal of the current
policy of allowing FDI in Pharmaceutical
companies; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and
Government's decision thereon?
Promotion of coffee production at
Palani Hills, Tamil Nadu
623. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the coffee
production at Palani Hills, Tamil Nadu has
come down by half due to lack of promotion
by Government;
(b) the steps, if any, taken by
Government to boost export potential of
coffee grown at Palani Hills; and
(c) whether the Coffee Board of India
has been working with coffee cultivators
to sustain coffee production in this region,
and if so, the details thereof?

143
Setting up of a regulatory authority to
monitor entry of FDIs
624. DR. PRADEEP KUMAR
BALMUCHU: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
increase the Foreign Direct Investment
(FDI) in the Industries sector, if so, the
details thereof;
(b) whether the Standing Committee on
Industry has recommended for creation of
a retail regulatory authority to monitor the
entry of FDIs and also its impact on Micro,
Small and Medium Enterprises; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to protect the MSMEs in the
list of increased FDIs?
Pak-India Y oung Entrepreneurs
Bilateral Summit, Islamabad
625. SHRI SALIM ANSARI:
SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a group of 25
Indian entrepreneurs have recently gone to
Pakistan to explore business and
investment opportunities under Pak-India
Young Entrepreneurs Bilateral Summit held
in Islamabad in October, 2013;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) to what extent the Indian delegation
to Pakistan have yielded results in various
fields of business deals between the two
countries?
Priority for setting up of private
industrial parks
626. SHRI PIYUSH GOYAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
give priority to setting up of private
industrial parks to pursue industrial
infrastructural development as well as to
mitigate the problem of unemployment in
the country, if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government is
contemplating to enhance the quantum of
investment of its Gross Domestic Product
in research and development activities for
sustaining high growth in future; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Increase in incoming investment
627. SHRI BHUPENDER YADAV:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been any
significant increase in incoming investment
since the announcement of the
Government's policy on Foreign Direct
Investment (FDI) in various sectors in
recent months; and
(b) whether there exists a tracking
system to help Government evaluate large
scale investments in both the public and
private sectors and if so, the sector-wise
details thereof?
Facilities for visitors by ITPO during
International Trade Fairs
628. SHRI SHIVANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of visitors in
various trade fairs including International

144

Promotion Organisation (ITPO) during the
last five years i.e. 2008-12;
(b) the total amount received as ticket
fee from the visitors as well as the money
received from the stalls/shops/State
Governments during the last five years;
(c) the total amount received from the
auction of parking areas meant for visitors;
